bear_assumptions: USD 1.00 normalized common EPS at 18x if realized pricing or government support weakens, qualification and 10X slip, high capital needs persist and dilution absorbs operating progress.
base_assumptions: USD 2.00 normalized common EPS at 20x if Q2 Materials execution persists, Independence qualifies, 10X stays on plan and liquidity funds the build without severe incremental dilution.
bull_assumptions: USD 3.00 normalized common EPS at 24x if separated products and magnets scale, contracted economics convert to cash, customers diversify and capital intensity falls without material dilution.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if the market price reaches the deterministic buy-below zone while current primary evidence preserves normalized earnings, liquidity and execution assumptions; downgrade if contract support, financing capacity, qualification, construction or common-share economics deteriorate.
